style_summary: Electric-green character key art crushed into coarse circular screen and acid-lime square dither, with industrial titles and abrupt straight print splices. The image emerges from damaged information, not polished illustration.

environment_variables.SUBJECT: Original human character and action with minimal surviving detail
environment_variables.DESIGN_DIRECTION: Case-specific scale, crop and paired-ratio arrangement

style_fidelity_anchors: [CORE] Original dystopian human character key art is reduced to faceless black masses and violent fluorescent screenprint.
[CORE] Electric green fields and round clustered dots carry R1, while acid-lime angular compressed titles and large square dither carry R2 visibly in every case.
[CORE] The coarse screen IS the drawing: cells spaced 0.7–1.2 percent of the short edge erase features, leaving only a few face planes and no fine linework.
[CORE] Use electric green for ground and hero highlights, dead black for shadows and knockout blocks, and acid lime for the oversized title and square-screen highlights.
[CORE] Flat clipped exposure crushes skin, fabric and props into ink; no glossy lighting, smooth shading, wrinkles, anime eyes or illustrative outlines survive.
[CORE] Movable black knockout blocks and a straight scan-splice interrupt the heavy human mass, with about 28–32 percent genuinely quiet solid field.
[CORE] Angular condensed upright industrial sans letters are large and solid with blunt clipped corners; the primary name stays exactly readable through aggressive image collisions.
[FLEX] Move and rotate the title, switch close and full-body crops, and relocate the straight splice to express each character story.
[FLEX] Round screen may merge into square cells locally, while whole masses bleed off edges and broad voids swallow secondary detail.
source_content_to_avoid: MARATHON and ESCAPE WILL MAKE ME GOD wording
Reference tactical masked character, armor, cross emblem and exact pose
Reference top-left tiny branding and top-right slogan pairing
Reference left vertical title rail, circle-and-bar symbol and right portrait column
Archived RELAY, BRINE, PARALLAX and MNEME names and their courier, listener, surveyor and archivist concepts
Any stair-step layout device, watermark, username, logo or QR code

visual_deconstruction.genre: Dystopian human character key art / raw underground screenprint poster
visual_deconstruction.grammar: Two-ink brutal print behavior, binary shadow masses, coarse screen-built bodies, machine sans, hard type-image scale conflict.

signature.R1: Transform electric-green tactical portrait plus tiny top header into loose-clothed outcast figures collided by huge acid-lime type.
signature.R2: Replace fixed left title rail and circle-bar diagram with movable knockout blocks and straight scan-splices; no cloned side-column layout.

fusion.genre_and_hero: Shared R1/R2 human character key art, new outcast identities
fusion.palette: R1 electric green main fields and hero light; R2 acid-lime title and square highlight zones; shared black shadows
fusion.finish: R1 circular clustered dots and merged blacks + R2 large square ordered dither, both construct rather than decorate the figure
fusion.type: R2 heavy angular condensed industrial title; R1 blunt ink-edge softness
fusion.layout: R1 monumental invasive crop + R2 strong solid black/type structure, both transformed into movable knockout blocks and straight splice
fusion.secondary_elements: R2 machine geometry reduced to one straight interruption, removing circle-bar identity
fusion.energy: Shared harsh binary contrast and coarse information loss, R1 breathing field plus R2 dense image zone

energy.density: 68–72 percent active area; 28–32 percent quiet field, derived from R1 30–35 and R2 20–25 percent estimates
energy.layering: 2–3 hard ink planes; title and body collide; straight splice divides one image
energy.disorder: Screen dropout, clumped dots, jagged threshold edges; no invented dust, scratches or distressed paper
energy.tension: Overscale anatomy, aggressive edge crop, huge title pressure, face almost erased; no calm illustration finish

series_constants.palette_roles: electric green ground/hero, black shadow/block, acid lime title/square highlights
series_constants.light: same flat violently clipped exposure, no light temperature modeling
series_constants.kit: coarse round and square screen, movable solid knockout block, one straight scan splice, broad quiet field
series_constants.title: solid angular compressed upright sans, lime on black, primary name only

visual_deconstruction.anchor_balance: Visible R1 contribution: green field + circular black-mass anatomy; visible R2 contribution: lime machine title + square dither. Genre, exposure and energy shared; neither relegated to a small accent.

composition.structure: Heavy screened human mass interlocks with oversized solid title blocks; open fields carry tension. Straight splice may be horizontal or diagonal but never stairs.
composition.design_layer: At least a quarter of frame through knockout blocks, title and flat fields; never image plus small caption.
composition.placement: First-ratio titles top, bottom, right vertical, center diagonal. Main masses left, right, left/bottom, right. Recompose each companion rather than crop or pad.

typography.class: Extremely heavy condensed angular industrial sans, squared counters and clipped corners, upright letters even if whole word rotates
typography.primary: MAIN_TEXT exactly, each letter readable; no subtitle or added punctuation
typography.secondary: No texture copy needed; structure comes from ink and type, not fake metadata

image_treatment.method: Binary photo-derived xerox/screenprint; no outlined illustration underneath. Round and square cells spaced 0.7–1.2% of short edge, roughly 7–12 pixels per 1000px width. Across eyes only a few cells survive. Blacks merge; highlight holes make shape.
image_treatment.region: Screen only in human and prop zones; solid fields remain uninterrupted. Square region substantial, at least a quarter of image mass; round region also substantial.
image_treatment.finish: Harsh clipped planes, clumping and missing information, slight plate-edge roughness; no soft gradients or paper aging.

design_rules: Screen constructs anatomy; detailed polished figure with dot overlay fails.
Keep both source contributions large and visible in every sample.
Change title orientation and body placement across the series.
Use genuine full-frame ratio recomposition without padding.
Preserve readable exact primary name while allowing bold collisions.
do: Destroy small details until the human exists as a few threatening ink masses.
Maintain clean solid negative fields against violent coarse image density.
Build title-image collisions from the character action.
avoid: Fine uniform texture over detailed drawing
Anime face, crisp wrinkles, polished musculature, hair strands or fabric seams
Reference costume, emblem, composition or wording
Stair steps, circle-bar symbol or repeated left title rail
Soft bloom, cinematic gradients, paper stains, extra white or grey ink
negative_prompt: polished comic illustration, manga eyes, crisp wrinkles, intact skin detail, fine halftone veil, hair strands, anatomical contour drawing, 3D gloss, soft gradient, vignette, bloom, dirty paper, decorative scratches, stair-step layout, MARATHON, cross emblem, circle-bar logo, uniform title rail, extra primary text, padded aspect ratio

values.SUBJECT: A hooded voltage thief in a loose rubber smock hangs by one hand from a thick overhead cable, shoulders twisted towards us; face is an almost empty black cavity.
values.DESIGN_DIRECTION: Low-angle torso rises on the left; raised arm exits above. Portrait title across top black block, lower-right quiet green. Wide version arm spans diagonally across width and title occupies lower-right. Round dots build shoulder; square dither devours hood and forearm. A single straight horizontal scan break severs the torso image.

values.SUBJECT: A shaven-headed underground bareknuckle combatant punches a huge wrapped fist towards the lens; small head is almost lost behind the fist, no facial detail.
values.DESIGN_DIRECTION: Foreshortened fist swells center-right, head upper-left. Portrait title across lower black block with fist intruding slightly; top-right quiet green. Wide version head far-left, fist fills right half and title runs along low edge. Square-screen knuckles collide with round-screen arm, interrupted by a short oblique black splice.

values.SUBJECT: A bareheaded contamination fugitive in a fitted dark sleeveless underlayer and plain trousers strides sideways while ripping a ragged plastic poncho up and off the body. Three-quarter side view at body height, both arms flung up; exposed head, neck, torso and separated legs form an instantly legible human silhouette. The torn sheet flies up and away as a second broad mass, connected only at the raised hands, with a large green gap between sheet and body. Molting is visibly something peeling off a body, never a hooded figure or top-down crouch. Face stays erased.
values.DESIGN_DIRECTION: Portrait: dynamic side-on body rises from lower-left/center, separated striding legs crop at the bottom, arms lift toward upper-right; a large ragged square-dither sheet blows across the upper area as a distinct flying mass. Strong flat green negative space separates sheet from bare head and torso. Horizontal condensed MOLT sits in the MIDDLE zone on a black scan-splice knockout, interlocking with the gap and body edge without hiding the shedding action; no top, bottom or side title rail. Wide: recompose the same peeling gesture across the width, body left/center and separate sheet sweeping upper-right, green gap clearly open; MOLT remains mid-height in a compact black block in that gap. Coarse round dots build body, coarse lime square cells build sheet; screen creates broad planes, with no wrinkles or facial linework. Keep the existing series palette, clipped exposure, distressed angular condensed upright type and roughly 28–32 percent quiet solid field.

values.SUBJECT: A pirate broadcast agitator screams into a blunt cylindrical microphone; extreme open-mouth and jaw crop, eyes and crown outside frame, one human only.
values.DESIGN_DIRECTION: Bold case: mouth becomes a huge almost abstract black hole within coarse round dots; microphone is square-screen blocks. Portrait jaw dominates right, quiet black left wedge, huge oblique title cuts through center at jaw level. Wide mouth center-left, microphone lower-right, title across upper-middle. Hard crop bleeds three edges; no individual teeth, lip lines or skin contours.
